hardFailures.pageText: Built as four plain-text rule files (sources, synthesis, translation, transcripts) injected verbatim into each AI step

The four skeleton files govern the client-brief stage".

hardFailures.pageText: every spec-shaped token must appear byte-for-byte in config/channel_specs.json (PRD DR-7)
hardFailures.evidence: pipeline/creative.py:66 checks only ("resolution", "aspect_ratio"). Line 74 normalizes whitespace and replaces "×" with "x". Lines 107–113 explicitly permit an invented ratio whose denominator is 10–59. Direct checks returned no violations for "1080 × 1920", "7:17", and "999-9999s · AVI".
hardFailures.why: The gate does not guarantee byte-for-byte membership for every spec token. It normalizes dimensions, exempts some ratio-shaped values, and does not validate duration or file-type tokens.
